d:
In this episode of Son Of Abish, Sorabh Pant dials the Minister of Home Affairs(Amit Shah), Sonali Thakker reveals the lesser-known fact about Abish and his calendar, Shreeja Chaturvedi graciously cancels her performance in the auditorium to stay back for this episode & the crowd queries Pavitra Shetty over her willingness to marry. Enjoyyyy & comment "Gulab Jamun" if you've read the description too!
Special thanks to Yash Barse for appearing on Son of Abish Picks and singing his song Land of Dreams.
